name: Single-Leg Hop
steps: Balance tall on one foot at the start of an open lane with your free foot lifted slightly behind you.
Drop briefly into a shallow single-leg quarter squat while swinging both arms backward.
Drive explosively forward and upward off your standing leg while swinging your arms ahead to leap forward.
Land softly on the same foot with bent hip and knee to stick the balance, then switch legs after completing one side.
tips: Stabilize each landing quietly with your knee aligned over your toes before initiating the next hop.
Keep your hips level on takeoff and landing rather than letting your free hip drop sideways.
